fields.acceptance: daemon-install.txtar runs install with a known PATH and TMPDIR (one holding a space) and checks the unit carries Environment=PATH=... and Environment=TMPDIR=... with those values, quoted the way systemd reads them, next to ExecStart ending in daemon --autonomous; a second install with the same environment writes nothing, and one with a changed PATH rewrites the unit and reloads systemd
fields.statement: rhiza daemon install writes the PATH and TMPDIR of the shell that runs it into the systemd unit as Environment= lines, quoted like ExecStart, so the service starts agents with the same tools on PATH and the same temp dir as the Rex tab, with no hand-written drop-in
